_description: Three-arm matched-control claim for cascade-compression 0.2.0rc7, aggregated on infra01 from the PRODUCTION RHPDS fleet (2026-10-22). The signal population is platform-wide production volume from live RHPDS environments — real users' labs and demos — collected by the production collector set (babylon, agnosticv, poolboy, labagator, prometheus, k8s, aap, ceph, ovn, gitops, jira, confluence, git), not a synthetic or test load. The workload is operated by the claiming organization (RHPDS ops). SUPersedes the earlier cascade cost-avoidance claims (examples/claims.json cascade.model-calls-avoided — modeled baseline; examples/cascade-infra01-pilot-24h.json cascade.full-business-impact — smaller pilot, and an ID that overclaimed its scope). Every number below was OBSERVED in the three-arm comparison over identical frozen inputs; none are modeled. Scope limits are binding: one 24h window, production RHPDS fleet traffic aggregated at infra01, deterministic tier only, engine digest-verified (0.2.0rc7 wheel b586e62d). The comparison was pre-registered: the dangerous-miss definition (final state of a recurring event hidden by suppression) was declared before the arms ran, and the synthetic rehearsal predicted the result shape.

_data_sources.three_arm_report: cascade-compression repo: three-arm-report.json (817,479 observations, 1,441 polls, 6 failed polls recorded, 5,019 unique events, capture digest frozen)
_data_sources.engine_identity: released 0.2.0rc7, wheel sha256 b586e62d (digest-verified; no local-module substitution)
_data_sources.signal_origin: production RHPDS fleet environments, aggregated at infra01 by the production collector set
_data_sources.window: 24h, production traffic, Warning-stream workload dominated by actively recurring events

_supersedes: cascade.model-calls-avoided (modeled baseline — weak counterfactual method, retired)
cascade.full-business-impact (matched control but smaller pilot window; ID overclaimed scope; retired)

arm_a_actual_workflow.note: Baseline: everything delivered to an agent — what an everything-to-AI architecture pays for production RHPDS fleet volume

arm_b_naive_exact_repeat_filter.note: The naive filter collapses each actively recurring event to its first snapshot, hiding the final state of 145 of 215 recurring events (67%)

arm_c_candidate_rc7.note: Verified-repeat-only suppression; the engine refuses to collapse growth, which is what makes it safe at zero misses

measurement.dangerous_miss_definition: pre-registered: the final state of a recurring event is hidden by suppression (operator sees a day-old count while the problem is still growing)

counterfactual.note: Both alternatives measured on identical frozen inputs: the do-nothing baseline (arm A) and the naive filter an operator would otherwise reach for (arm B). This is the top of the counterfactual ladder available without randomized rollout.

competing_factors: a hand-tuned exact-repeat filter with growth-aware exceptions could close part of the gap, at the cost of bespoke per-stream engineering
the workload (recurring-warning-dominated stream) was favorable to the miss definition; other stream shapes may differ

financial_model.note: No financial model is claimed: the three-arm measured miss counts, not incident dollars. An incident-cost model would be a separate claim requiring its own baseline.

scope_limits: one 24h window over production RHPDS fleet signals (aggregated at infra01); operated by the claiming organization
215 recurring events is a small denominator for the miss-rate estimate
workload-shape dependent; not portable to dissimilar streams without re-measurement

components: engine deployment and collector wiring (already operational on infra01)
retention/storage for 748,787 retained observations per day per cluster (measured capture: ~514 MB/24h)
ledger write volume (~20/sec sustained, 13M+ entries accumulated over 75 days)
realization_cost.note: Infrastructure realization costs are observed but not yet priced into a net figure; a net-value claim requires pricing these components.

measurement.note_on_the_linkage: The three-arm measured DUPLICATE SUPPRESSION, not model calls. Converting dedupes to model-calls-avoided depends on tier routing (which suppressed observations would otherwise have reached a model tier). This claim deliberately reports the measured quantity; the earlier model-calls figures (470, 8200) relied on tier-routing assumptions this evidence does not re-establish. A calls-avoided figure for this workload requires the routing ledger from a full-stack arm, which the deterministic-tier comparison did not include.

counterfactual.note: Arm A (actual workflow) delivered all 817,479 observations; arm C suppressed 68,692 as verified duplicates with zero dangerous misses. Arm B suppressed far more (99.3%) but at 145 dangerous misses — compression volume is only claimable together with the miss count, which is why this claim and cascade.dangerous-miss-avoidance-24h are paired.

competing_factors: exact-repeat deduplication is achievable without this engine; the engine's contribution is suppressing only VERIFIED repeats (zero dangerous misses), not the raw dedupe count
most repeat volume on this stream is CHANGED observations (new information, correctly retained) — the 8.4% figure is the honest workload-specific ceiling, not a general compression rate

financial_model.note: No dollar figure is claimed: dedupe-to-call conversion is tier-routing dependent (see measurement.note_on_the_linkage) and per-call pricing is not customer-validated.

scope_limits: one 24h window, production RHPDS fleet traffic, deterministic tier
8.4% is workload-shape dependent — recurring-warning-dominated stream; NOT a portable compression rate
measured in observations suppressed, not model calls (see linkage note)

components: same infrastructure components as the paired quality claim
verification compute for repeat verification (CPU-only, measured within the soak capture)
realization_cost.note: Paired with cascade.dangerous-miss-avoidance-24h; neither claim is complete without the other.
